seo.title: Contact – Lawyer Warsaw | Tomasz Kowalski, Esq.
seo.description: Law Office of Tomasz Kowalski, Esq. Warsaw, ul. Marszałkowska 42/15. Tel: +48 22 123 45 67. Free consultation.

hero.headline: Get in touch
hero.subheadline: The first consultation is free. Describe your situation, and I will assess the prospects and propose a strategy. I respond within 24 hours – considerably faster in urgent cases.

phones.label: Mobile (urgent cases)
phones.description: Available 24/7 for urgent matters – detention, search, summons

form.title: Describe your case
form.description: Fill in the form below and I will get back to you within 24 hours. In urgent cases, call the mobile number directly.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Brief case description
fields.placeholder: Briefly describe the circumstances – what happened, what stage the proceedings are at, what you need. Do not provide full names or personal data of third parties.

form.disclaimer: Your data is protected in accordance with the privacy policy and GDPR. We respond within 24 hours. This form does not constitute legal advice.
form.successMessage: Thank you for your message. I will get back to you within 24 hours.
form.errorMessage: An error occurred. Please try again or call +48 22 123 45 67.

map.title: How to get here
map.description: The office is located in central Warsaw, near the Politechnika metro station. Accessible by public transport or car – paid car parks are available nearby.

directions.title: By metro
directions.description: Politechnika station (line M1), 3 minutes on foot from the office. Exit towards ul. Marszałkowska.

directions.title: By car
directions.description: Underground car park at Plac Unii Lubelskiej shopping centre (200 m) or on-street parking on ul. Nowogrodzkiej.

items.title: Privacy guaranteed
items.description: All information you provide to me is protected by legal professional privilege. I do not disclose data to third parties or authorities without your consent – except as required by law.

items.title: I respond quickly
items.description: In standard cases I respond within 24 hours. In urgent matters – detention, search, summons – the mobile phone is available 24/7.

items.title: Free first consultation
items.description: The first meeting is free and non-binding. I want you to get to know me and my working methods before deciding to engage my services.
